title: Typing and voice typing as writing tools
examples: How do I use voice typing?
Can I talk instead of writing?

explain.say: Here is some good news: writing does not always need a pencil! Typing and voice typing are real writing tools that lots of people use every day. Look at the two tools on the board.

explain.say: Look at typing. You press keys, and neat letters appear every time. Spotted a mistake? Just delete it and try again. No rubbing out! Can you find the letters of your name on a keyboard?

right.title: Voice typing
points: Say full stop for a dot

explain.say: Now voice typing. You talk, and the device writes your words for you. It is great for getting big ideas down fast. What sentence would you like to say?

right.title: Voice typing
points: Say full stop for a dot

explain.say: Here is how to voice type. Tap the microphone button and speak clearly. At the end of a sentence, say full stop. Some devices want you to say period instead. Can you try one sentence?

explain.say: Last, read it back. Sometimes the device mishears a word, so check and fix it. Wonderful! Your brain learns in its own way, and lots of brilliant people learn like this. A teacher or grown-up can set the tools up.

faq.a: Yes! Writing means putting your ideas into words. Typing and voice typing are just different tools for doing it.

faq.q: How do I use voice typing?
faq.a: Tap the microphone button on the keyboard, then speak clearly. Say full stop or period at the end of each sentence, then read it back.

faq.q: What if voice typing gets a word wrong?
faq.a: That happens to everyone. Tap the wrong word and fix it, or say it again more clearly.
asks: Voice typing wrote the wrong word

faq.a: A little practice is good, for things like your name and short notes. For long writing, it is fine to use the tool that helps you most.

faq.q: How can I get faster at typing?
faq.a: Practise for a few minutes a day with a typing game, keeping your fingers on the middle row of keys. A teacher or grown-up can help you find one.

facts: Voice typing, also called speech to text, is built into most phones, tablets and computers.
In many voice typing tools, saying full stop or period adds a dot at the end of a sentence.

quiz.say: What should you do after voice typing a sentence?
quiz.why: The device can mishear, so read it back and fix any slips.

wrong.1: No need to delete it. Just check it.
wrong.2: Checking helps you catch words the device got wrong.

quiz.say: What is one good thing about typing?

options.show: You do not need any fingers
options.say: You do not need any fingers

quiz.why: You can delete a mistake and type it again, with no rubbing out.

wrong.1: Typing uses your fingers to press the keys.
wrong.2: Computers and tablets need power to work.
